headline.zh: 企业 AI 代理接入与授权

scenario.zh: 为销售团队部署 AI 代理,需要统一管理 CRM 访问权限和 LLM 调用成本
scenario.en: Deploy AI agents for sales team with unified CRM access control and LLM cost management

instruction.zh: 从实际业务需求出发配置
instruction.en: Configure based on actual business needs

output.zh: 代理可通过身份验证访问 Salesforce,无需共享凭据
output.en: Agents access Salesforce via identity auth without sharing credentials

input.zh:
sales-assistant 请求读取 Salesforce 联系人
data-sync 请求写入 Google Sheets
input.en:
sales-assistant requests Salesforce contact read
data-sync requests Google Sheets write

output.zh:
sales-assistant:已授权 Salesforce 只读
data-sync:已授权 Sheets 区域 A1:D100
output.en:
sales-assistant: Salesforce read-only granted
data-sync: Sheets range A1:D100 granted

detail.zh: 每个代理分配独立身份凭证,可随时撤销
detail.en: Each agent gets separate identity, revocable anytime

detail.zh: 按资源类型和操作范围限制访问
detail.en: Restrict access by resource type and operation scope

output.zh: 简单查询用 GPT-4o-mini,复杂分析用 Claude,月度预算锁定
output.en: Simple queries use GPT-4o-mini, complex analysis uses Claude with monthly budget cap

input.zh:
客服代理:每日 800 次简单问答
分析代理:每周 50 次深度报告
input.en:
Support agent: 800 daily simple Q&A
Analytics agent: 50 weekly deep reports

output.zh:
客服→GPT-4o-mini 每月限额 200 美元
分析→Claude Sonnet 每次最多 8k token
output.en:
Support→GPT-4o-mini capped at $200/month
Analytics→Claude Sonnet max 8k tokens per call

instruction.zh: 所有代理操作可追溯审计

output.zh: 识别异常调用模式和成本峰值
output.en: Identify unusual call patterns and cost spikes

input.zh:
sales-assistant:周三调用量突增至平时三倍
data-sync:持续访问已删除的工作表
input.en:
sales-assistant: Wednesday calls tripled usual volume
data-sync: repeatedly accessing deleted worksheet

output.zh:
sales-assistant 需检查触发逻辑
data-sync 权限配置需更新
output.en:
sales-assistant trigger logic needs review
data-sync permission config needs update

detail.zh: 记录每次 API 调用的时间、参数和响应
detail.en: Log timestamp, parameters and response for each API call

detail.zh: 按代理和团队拆分 LLM 使用费用
detail.en: Break down LLM costs by agent and team

takeaway.zh: 演示了 MCP 网关授权和 LLM 路由的配置示例;实际部署需在 Mintive 平台连接企业系统并设置具体权限策略
takeaway.en: Illustrated MCP gateway authorization and LLM routing configuration examples; actual deployment requires connecting enterprise systems and setting specific permission policies on Mintive platform
